title: [BUG] DINOv3 Model Export for CoreML fails
author: jbadger3

comments.author: rwightman
comments.body:
@jbadger3 seems this has been an issue for a long time because coreml does not support the 'tensor_split' op for some reason. You cannot use the other Attention impl as it doesn't support ROPE embeds and this issue is specific to the use of split in the timm ROPE impl.

You can fix by doing  change split at https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/1ec391520aeebe580b0340fcb795cda30d08ef70/timm/layers/pos_embed_sincos.py#L276

to 

`sin_emb, cos_emb = emb.chunk(2, -1)`

I'll make the change as there should be no negative impact or performance issues making this change. Silly that coreml cares though,.

comments.author: rwightman
comments.body: would have made the change sooner if someone had made me aware https://github.com/apple/coremltools/issues/2226

comments.author: jbadger3
comments.body: Thanks for the detailed explanations and fix.  Much appreciated! 🙏
